semiconductor_relevance: High — Analogue Insight is a fabless semiconductor company focused on high-performance analogue and mixed-signal design, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Analogue Insight Ltd specializes in high-performance analogue and mixed-signal design, offering both standard and custom IP solutions for advanced SoC and Chiplet applications. The company provides design consultancy and turnkey solutions, focusing on high-speed serial link technology for AI, industrial, and automotive markets.
capabilities: High-performance analogue and mixed-signal IP solutions
Custom chiplet design for high-speed applications

regional_presence.North America: The company supports clients across North America with its design consultancy services.
regional_presence.Europe: Analogue Insight also collaborates with clients in Europe, enhancing its market reach.
